scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,be -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:web+backend: concurrently -n web,be -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n web,desk -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:web:5174" "npm run dev --workspace=@agni/desktop"
scripts.dev:desktop+backend: concurrently -n web,desk,be -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm run dev:web:5174" "npm run dev --workspace=@agni/desktop" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build:desktop:wrapper: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.supabase:gen:types: SUPABASE_WORKDIR=backend supabase gen types typescript --local > apps/web/src/types/supabase.ts
